==Usage==
<code><nowiki>
{{Threads|username=|url=|name=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}
</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|username}} Threads handle of the user, such as <code>charlesdsoule</code>.
*{{Para|url}} URL to the post in question, such as <code>post/C2d_nSXM48P</code>.
*{{Para|name}} Actual name of the user, linked to Wookieepedia if possible, for example <code><nowiki>[[Charles Soule]]</nowiki></code>.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} The date the post was posted online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} Users are encouraged to utilize the optional "quote" field in the template whenever possible, as Threads posts are subject to permanent removal at any time.

===Example(s)===
Post:
<pre>
{{Threads|charlesdsoule|post/C2d_nSXM48P|[[Charles Soule]]|date=2024-01-24|quote=Star Wars 48-49 are Leia-focused and (I think) will be really good. Leia was just a kid through the OT. 19 in ANH, 22 in Empire. It was a lot.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/XtuqN}}
</pre>

Produces:

{{Threads|charlesdsoule|post/C2d_nSXM48P|[[Charles Soule]]|date=2024-01-24|quote=Star Wars 48-49 are Leia-focused and (I think) will be really good. Leia was just a kid through the OT. 19 in ANH, 22 in Empire. It was a lot.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/XtuqN}}

<hr />

Profile:
<code><nowiki>
{{Threads|username=charlesdsoule|name=[[Charles Soule]]}}
</nowiki></code>

Produces:

{{Threads|username=charlesdsoule|name=[[Charles Soule]]}}
